scientific_integrity: The theorem is proven by a self-contained ruler-valuation proof. Finite exhaustive checking at ranks 1–8 supports but does not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Literal finite Zimin words over distinct alphabet symbols only; circular factors limited to one full revolution. No independent mathematical audit. Specialist-priority uncertainty, especially unavailable complete text of Simpson (2014).
title: The complete circular-palindrome spectrum of finite Zimin words
